weatherScreen.title: Weather and flight window
weatherScreen.desc: Open-Meteo forecast for the farm, hourly limit checks and the departure hour

location.modeLabel: How to set the forecast point
location.farWarning: This is far from the farm — the weather there may differ.

hint.geocode: Start typing a city name and pick it from the suggestions.
hint.manual: Enter latitude and longitude in degrees, e.g. 48.215 and 40.284.

location.nothingFound: Nothing found. Check the name or enter coordinates.

chart.title: Hourly wind and precipitation
chart.windAria: Hourly wind and gust chart with limit lines
chart.precipAria: Hourly precipitation bars with the limit line
chart.note: Wind aloft is interpolated between the model levels 10, 80, 120 and 180 m; gusts are scaled by the gust-to-wind ratio near the ground.
chart.extrapolatedNote: Above 180 m the top model level is used — the actual wind may be stronger.
chart.extrapolatedShort: above 180 m — top model level value
chart.noPlan: No flight plan — wind at the mission flight altitude, {{alt}} m
chart.fromPlan: From the flight plan: transit {{transit}} m, maximum {{top}} m
chart.fromPlanSingle: From the flight plan: the whole flight at {{alt}} m

window.title: Flight window
window.subtitle: Hourly, farm time: {{zone}} ({{offset}})
window.noWindows: The forecast has no hours when flying is clearly OK.
window.pickStart: Make the start of this window the departure hour
window.clickHint: Click an hour to make it the departure hour. Past hours cannot be selected.

table.title: Hourly table
table.wind: Wind, m/s, and where it blows from

request.title: Forecast point and period

hoursErrors.notInteger: Must be a whole number of hours

request.source: Data: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0). The forecast is saved to the mission right away.

weatherScreen.stale: The forecast was fetched {{age}} and may be outdated. Refresh it before the flight.

toast.departureDropped: The selected departure hour is not in the new forecast — pick an hour again

empty.title: No forecast yet
empty.hint: Choose a point and press “Get forecast” — the snapshot is saved to the mission right away.
empty.readOnly: No forecast was saved for this mission.

clearConfirm.title: Clear the forecast?
clearConfirm.text: The forecast snapshot and the selected departure hour will be removed from the mission. The mission will not be ready to fly until a forecast is fetched again.

errors.locked: This mission has been flown — its forecast and departure hour cannot be changed.

flightForecast.title: Flight forecast

reasons.wind: wind {{value}} m/s with a limit of {{limit}} m/s
reasons.windAt: wind {{value}} m/s at {{alt}} m with a limit of {{limit}} m/s
reasons.gust: gusts {{value}} m/s with a limit of {{limit}} m/s
reasons.gustAt: gusts {{value}} m/s at {{alt}} m with a limit of {{limit}} m/s
reasons.precip: precipitation {{value}} mm/h with a limit of {{limit}} mm/h
reasons.visibility: visibility {{value}} km with a minimum of {{limit}} km
reasons.altitude: flight altitude {{value}} m above the ceiling of {{limit}} m
reasons.battery: worst case needs {{value}}% battery with {{limit}}% usable — one sortie is not enough
reasons.batteryImpossible: the headwind is close to the drone speed — the route cannot be flown

flightForecast.missingWind: No wind or gust data at {{alts}} m
flightForecast.allWithinLimits: All parameters are within the mission and drone limits.

estimate.title: Flight estimate
estimate.sortiesImpossible: The route cannot be flown against this wind
estimate.worstNote: Worst case: headwind along the whole route.

gaps.route: Compute the inspection route first — there is nothing to assess without it.
gaps.weather: Get a weather forecast for the mission.
gaps.departure: Pick a departure hour on the “Flight window” strip of the weather screen.
gaps.departureMissing: The selected departure hour is not in the saved forecast — refresh the forecast or pick the hour again.

flightForecast.readOnlyGap: This mission has been flown, and it has no saved data for a flight forecast.

planIssues.takeoff: No takeoff point — length, time and battery cannot be estimated.
planIssues.staleRoute: The inspection order refers to turbines that are no longer in the farm — recompute the route.

flightForecast.staleWeather: The forecast is older than 3 hours.
flightForecast.departurePast: The selected departure hour has already passed.
